scope: Bounded pre-save review of saved source policy, root-provided current candidate and two official Google help pages. No native control, external writes, new policy or shared edits.
candidate_provenance: Current native candidate and explicit owner no-restocking-fee confirmation supplied by root; not independently operated or read by this reviewer.

documented_facts.scope: How it works/examples, requirements and exception setup
documented_facts.finding: Google explicitly documents creating the standard policy first, then exceptions associated with specific products through return_policy_label. Merchant and website policies must be consistent.
Non-standard products require the return policy label; missing values use the default policy.

decision_reason: The standard policy can match ordinary eligible items while overstating returnability for excluded items that lack a return_policy_label. Creating an exception policy alone does not attach it to products. A saved September 10 zero count and a September 11 detail without a numeric count do not prove no affected offers can receive the default.
truth_gate: Before attesting and saving this default, confirm a supported, concrete route in the existing publisher/source to persist return_policy_label for the actual excluded product/variant cohort, and prepare the immediate exception-plus-label sequence with processed-offer readback. Do not assume Shopify tags or a created exception automatically populate that attribute.
permission_vs_accuracy: HOLD is an independent customer-truth judgment for this candidate, not a missing authority gate and not a claim that Google forbids its documented standard-first workflow.
required_completion: Use the selected 30-day policy's swimwear, intimates, explicitly marked Final Sale and gift-card exceptions without inventing classifications or broadening all sale items.
Confirm and prepare the current source's supported label-writing mechanism and the exact excluded offer bindings.

Once the staged sequence is concrete, create standard and exception policies in Google's supported order; verify the resulting policy labels and effective product assignments before claiming website consistency is complete.
Retain damaged/defective handling and customer-shipping exception; do not invent calendar-day refund duration or rewrite the conflicting Terms.
outstanding_conflicts: Terms also says all sale/personalized products are final sale and uses a different return-shipping exception. Existing conflict retained; no precedence judgment or rewrite in this review.
limits: Source bodies were verified in the saved September 10 snapshot, not freshly re-read from Shopify by this reviewer.
No proof of current receiver emptiness, actual policy verification status or processed return-policy labels.
Google approval/review delay is not assumed to contain a temporary inaccurate default.
next_action: Confirm the existing feed's concrete exception-label mechanism while retaining the unsubmitted review; no further fee or general scope approval is needed.
